briefs.name: VitusCare
briefs.brief: VitusCare is India's leading dialysis care provider, offering accessible and affordable kidney care in Tier 2, 3, and 4 cities with over 50 operational centers. The company is currently at a Series B stage, having raised $3,217,189 on November 19, 2026. It focuses on improving the quality of life through a World Class Dialysis Management Program for individuals and their families. A notable detail is its projection to achieve Rs 100 Cr ARR by 2026.

briefs.name: Elysian Aircraft
briefs.brief: Elysian Aircraft is developing the E9X, an 88-100 seat battery-electric aircraft, and core technologies to enable aviation's transition to electric flight. The E9X is designed to replace 50% of all scheduled flights on routes up to 1,000 km, targeting a 20% reduction in global aviation emissions. The company recently closed a $6,582,520 Pre-Series A funding round on November 19, 2026. Notably, they are backed by a strong patent portfolio and deep industry partnerships with Fokker Services Group, KLM, and Transavia.

briefs.name: Boba Bhai
briefs.brief: Boba Bhai is India's premier Korean-Indian fusion street food brand, established in 2023, offering 45+ bubble teas alongside dishes like corn dogs and ramen. It recently closed a Series B funding round, raising $18 million on November 19, 2026, and operates with a team of 202. The company has rapidly expanded to over 120 stores across India, fulfilling 300,000+ orders monthly across dine-in, takeaway, and delivery. A notable detail is its significant market reach, with packaged bubble tea now available in over 70 cities through quick commerce.

briefs.name: INFIFORCE Technology Group
briefs.brief: INFIFORCE Technology Group is a leading embodied AI company focused on developing next-generation AI brains for the physical world, notably AtomBrain, which enables robots to learn from real-world experience. They also offer DataGrid, a full-stack AI infrastructure, and multi-form-factor robotic platforms, forming an end-to-end technology ecosystem. The company is at the Series A stage, having raised approximately $15 million in November 2026. Notably, their technologies have been deployed across 30+ cities and 100+ real-world scenarios, demonstrating scalability and practical value.
